name: aggregates-min5
description: The toolkit's default policy for a project's aggregates; a project may set its own. Every published count is at least 5 or null, and every statistic rests on at least 5 true persons (the floor of 5 SCB uses); a regression term singles out 0 or at least 5 true persons, and leaves 0 or at least 5 beside it. Counts are cell-key perturbed by the pipeline (D 5, V 6.5, js 4), which the gate cannot verify, so it keeps the floor. Statistics have at most 4 significant digits. Known limit: no dominance rule, so a magnitude statistic over firms is the reviewer's to check. Rationale and sources: reg_export_gate/DESIGN.md.
